text_block_list.text:
Summer Training Camp had begun. 
Normally,
it was time to focus purely on training,
but—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah! How's Windy-chan's running?! 
Every single pair of eyes on this beach
should be on me—

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Biko-chan, you're on fire! 
Alright, I'm not gonna lose either!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best!
Just like those three... 
I'm definitely going to master the dirt
track!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
They're not looking at all! 
Uuuuugh... if that's how it's gonna be~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So annoying! 
So frustrating--!
Summer Training Camp is stuuupid!

The lack of attention was draining her
motivation, along with 
the focus required for practice...
This summer was shaping up to be tough.
Or so I thought, until—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh? The summer festival got cancelled?!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
Apparently it overlaps with the big 
summer festival in the neighboring town.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
If they held it at the same time,
everyone would 
just flock over there anyway,
so they decided 
to call it off this year...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Going to the next town would make curfew
tricky too... 
Haaah~ Guess no summer festival for us this
year.

I had planned on taking Shinko Windy to the
festival 
as a reward for her hard work...
but it couldn't be helped.

Even after night fell, Shinko 
Windy hadn't returned to the lodge.

I searched for her along an unlit
pathway. 
And then—
Kyaaa?!
Gyaaaa! H-Have mercy-!

Screams echoed from the other side of the
grove. 
Did something happen?
She didn't get caught up in trouble,
did she?

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text:
Whoooooa~~~~! This is thrilling! 
My mind is completely blown!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wah-ha-ha-ha! 
Come on,
step right up!
There's plenty more fun where that came
from!

Following the lively commotion,
I came upon rows of lantern lights 
and handmade banners—
it was an impromptu little festival.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Ah, Trainer! 
How do ya like Windy-chan's festival?
Packed and buzzing, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Wasabi-stuffed Takoyaki!
A raffle where every ticket wins the
exact same prize!
And our main stage event:
a Mystery Box Tournament!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
With Windy-chan's prank power on our
side, 
there's no way our festival's losing~!

text_block_list.name: Villager A
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaaaa--! 
Ahhh, I hit the wasabi takoyaki jackpot!

text_block_list.name: Villager B
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeek?! 
What's inside this box?!
It's all slimy and ice-cold~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, c'mon, take a guess~♪ 
Windy-chan's special prank props are waiting
inside~!

text_block_list.name: Villager C
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen a festival like this!
It's so wildly creative!

text_block_list.name: Villager D
text_block_list.text:
Right?! At this rate,
we won't even have to worry about
competing 
with the next town!
It's a completely unique experience!

text_block_list.name: Village Chief
text_block_list.text:
With the brilliant ideas this Tracen Academy
student gave us, 
we'd be fools not to put on the show! Right,
everyone?!

text_block_list.name: Villagers
text_block_list.text: Yeaaaaah!

Word quickly spread back to the training
camp, 
and Uma Musume began arriving in droves.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Windy-chan! 
This is so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Wasabi takoyaki... 
That was Windy-chan's idea? Incredible!

text_block_list.name: Villager A
text_block_list.text:
We never could've come up with these ideas
on our own. 
We'll definitely look forward to next year too,
thank you!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Ni-shi-shi♪

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Phew, it's finally all done~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Cleaning up is such a drag though...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well, duh! When it comes to pranks, 
Windy-chan is a certified genius!
You knew that already, right?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...You said it before, after all. 
That Windy-chan's creativity is amazing.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Being the Lord of Darkness, 
of course brilliant ideas keep welling up
inside me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Still, y'know... 
If Windy-chan kept all her genius locked
up...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It'd be... well, yeah! 
All those wicked ideas would go to waste!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So, I decided sharing a few 
little pranks wouldn't be the worst thing
ever.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...In short!
Distribute prank ideas to those in need! 
Make everyone rely on Windy-chan and turn
them into my loyal minions!
choice_data_list: There will probably be more now, huh
There will probably be more now, huh

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Now everyone in the world 
will crave Windy-chan's pranks!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Which means I'll be short on hands, so 
I'm officially appointing you as my permanent
minion assistant!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Aren't you super thrilled?

Her face was brimming with smug
anticipation. 
I nodded in agreement without a moment's
hesitation.
